summary.text: Megan Ann Mioduszewski is a Democratic candidate for the Maryland House of Delegates, District 6, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She previously ran for the same district in 2018 and 2022.

paragraphs.text: Megan Ann Mioduszewski advanced from the Democratic primary for Maryland House of Delegates District 6 on June 26, 2018, and finished fifth in the November 6, 2018 general election for the district's three seats with 13.2 percent of the vote.

She advanced from the July 19, 2022 Democratic primary with 52.4 percent of the vote and received 16.0 percent in the November 8, 2022 general election, in which three Republican incumbents won the seats.
She advanced from the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary and is on the November 2026 general election ballot for District 6.
